name: @fuyu/countdown
description: Count the days to birthdays, holidays and deadlines, or the days since an anniversary, with reminders and a day count on the collapsed bar.
author: TixXin

description.zh-CN: 记下生日、节日、截止日和纪念日，看还有几天或已经第几天，到日子提醒你，收起条上显示天数。
description.en: Count the days to birthdays, holidays and deadlines, or the days since an anniversary, with reminders and a day count on the collapsed bar.
